ov: Fourteen species of small deer from South and Southeast Asia, also called barking deer. Males have short antlers but fight with long, downward-pointing canine "tusks". Reeves's muntjac has spread widely in England after releases and escapes from Woburn Abbey in the early 1900s.

why.et: Its low-fat meat is noted for its culinary qualities.

ht: Reeves's muntjac: up to 50 cm at the shoulder
rg: South and Southeast Asia, southern China and Taiwan; Reeves's muntjac introduced to Britain, Ireland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Japan.
df: Herbs, blossoms, shoots, fungi, berries, grasses and nuts, and occasionally eggs and carrion.
fx: The southern red muntjac has the lowest chromosome number of any mammal: 7 in males and just 6 in females.
Muntjacs can mate at any time of year, a habit they kept even after being introduced to cooler countries.
